ext_name.description: Extension name; also the camera name pages show. Not translated.

ext_description.message: Gives web pages Remote Visio Camera, Microphone and Speaker, linked to your sending device through Remote Visio.
ext_description.description: Extension description in the extensions page (at most 132 characters). The three device names are not translated.

slate_connecting.description: Slate (the picture shown instead of the camera): connecting to the receiver.

slate_waiting.description: Slate: connected, but the sending device sends no camera.

slate_waiting_hint.message: Turn the camera on with the camera button on the sending device
slate_waiting_hint.description: Slate, under slate_waiting: the sending page's camera button (its round camera switch) is off.

slate_down.message: Remote Visio is not running on this Mac
slate_down.description: Slate: the Remote Visio receiver does not answer.

slate_down_hint.message: Already running? If its menu has no item for the browser extension, update Remote Visio.
slate_down_hint.description: Slate, under slate_down. An older Remote Visio has no browser camera and reads as not running; its menu has neither bcam_install nor bcam_reinstall of the menu-bar app.

slate_refused.message: Remote Visio does not accept this copy of the extension
slate_refused.description: Slate: the receiver refused this extension's ID: a copy it does not know, such as one unpacked from the Chrome Web Store zip (no key, so an ID of its own).

slate_refused_hint.message: Remove it on the browser's extensions page, then choose “Install Browser Extension…” in the Remote Visio menu.
slate_refused_hint.description: Under slate_refused. Quotes the menu item bcam_install of the menu-bar app.

slate_off.message: The browser camera is turned off in Remote Visio
slate_off.description: Slate: the receiver runs with the browser camera turned off, which only one started by hand with -browser-camera=false does (the menu-bar app always turns it on).

slate_busy.message: The camera is busy: too many pages are using it
slate_busy.description: Slate: the receiver serves too many pages already.

slate_codec.message: This browser cannot play the camera's H.264 video
slate_codec.description: Slate: the browser offered no H.264 decoder.

slate_blocked.message: This browser blocked the local connection to Remote Visio
slate_blocked.description: Slate: the receiver answered, but the browser never let the connection to it come up (a WebRTC policy or setting, or a refused local network access).

slate_blocked_hint.message: In this site's settings, allow it to access other apps and services on this device, or ask your IT department about the browser's WebRTC policy

popup_question.description: Popup: a consent window is open for this site, and may have gone behind the browser's window; popup_question_show brings it back.

popup_question_show.description: Popup: button next to popup_question that brings the consent window to the front.

popup_checking.description: Popup status before the first answer.

popup_device_camera.description: Popup: name of the camera's row in the status card.

popup_device_microphone.description: Popup: name of the microphone's row in the status card.

popup_device_speaker.description: Popup: name of the speaker's row in the status card.

popup_status_down.message: Remote Visio is not running on this Mac
popup_status_down.description: Popup status: the receiver does not answer.

popup_status_down_hint.message: Already running? If its menu has no item for the browser extension, update Remote Visio.
popup_status_down_hint.description: Popup, under popup_status_down. An older Remote Visio has no browser camera and reads as not running; its menu has neither bcam_install nor bcam_reinstall of the menu-bar app.

popup_status_refused.message: Remote Visio does not accept this copy of the extension
popup_status_refused.description: Popup status: the receiver refused this extension's ID: a copy it does not know, such as one unpacked from the Chrome Web Store zip (no key, so an ID of its own).

popup_status_refused_hint.message: Remove it on the browser's extensions page, then choose “Install Browser Extension…” in the Remote Visio menu.
popup_status_refused_hint.description: Under popup_status_refused. Quotes the menu item bcam_install of the menu-bar app.

popup_status_off.message: The browser camera is turned off in Remote Visio
popup_status_off.description: Popup status: the receiver runs with the browser camera turned off (one started by hand with -browser-camera=false).

popup_status_waiting_hint.message: Turn the camera on with the camera button on the sending device.
popup_status_waiting_hint.description: Popup, under popup_status_waiting: the sending page's camera button is off.

popup_update.message: Update Remote Visio on this Mac to use it
popup_update.description: Popup, microphone and speaker rows: the receiver is an older Remote Visio, without the browser microphone and speaker.

popup_mic_receiving.description: Popup, microphone row: the sending device's microphone arrives.

popup_mic_waiting.message: Waiting for the sending device's microphone
popup_mic_waiting.description: Popup, microphone row: nothing arrives from the sending device's microphone.

popup_mic_waiting_hint.description: Popup, microphone row: no sending page has started; quotes the sending page's Start button (its label in this language).

popup_mic_off.description: Popup, microphone row: the receiver has the browser microphone turned off.

popup_speaker_sending.message: Sending $SITE$'s sound to the sending device
popup_speaker_sending.description: Popup, speaker row: the sound of this site (played into Remote Visio Speaker) goes to the sending device.

popup_speaker_idle.message: No page is sending its sound
popup_speaker_idle.description: Popup, speaker row: no page sends its sound.

popup_speaker_idle_hint.message: Choose “Remote Visio Speaker” as the speaker on your meeting's website.

popup_speaker_not_listening.message: The sending device is not listening
popup_speaker_not_listening.description: Popup, speaker row: no sending device takes the sound back (none is started, or it runs on this Mac).

popup_speaker_not_listening_hint.message: Start Remote Visio on the sending device; a sending page on this Mac itself gets no sound back.
popup_speaker_not_listening_hint.description: Popup, speaker row: no sender takes the sound back. The sending page always does once started (its speaker button only mutes it there), so either none is started, or it runs on this Mac (which gets no sound back, to avoid a loop), or a sender app has its speaker off.

popup_speaker_off.description: Popup, speaker row: the receiver runs with the return path (the speaker) turned off.

popup_in_use_count.description: Popup: the sites watching now, when there are more connections than sites (several pages of a site, or connections that named no site). COUNT is always 2 or more.

popup_in_use_unnamed.description: Popup: connections watching that did not come from a site through this extension.

popup_enabled.message: Offer Remote Visio's devices to websites
popup_enabled.description: Popup switch: add Remote Visio's camera, microphone and speaker to web pages.

popup_enabled_hint.message: Sites list Remote Visio Camera, Microphone and Speaker with their own devices. You are asked before a site uses them for the first time.

popup_prefer.description: Popup switch: answer requests for any camera or microphone with Remote Visio's, and send the sound of allowed sites to the sending device.

popup_prefer_hint.message: Sites that ask for any camera or microphone get Remote Visio's, and what the sites you allowed play goes to the sending device while Remote Visio runs.

popup_sites.description: Popup: heading of the list of sites.

popup_no_sites.message: No site has asked for Remote Visio yet.
popup_no_sites.description: Popup: the list of sites is empty.

popup_site_allowed.description: Popup: a site the user allowed.

popup_site_blocked.description: Popup: a site the user refused.

popup_site_camera_only.description: Popup: a site an older version of the extension allowed to use the camera only; it is asked again before it gets the microphone or the speaker.

popup_site_remove.description: Popup: button that forgets a site's answer.

consent_question.message: Allow $ORIGIN$ to use Remote Visio's camera, microphone and speaker?
consent_question.description: Consent window question. One answer covers the three devices.

consent_embedded.message: Asked by $FRAME$, embedded in this site.
consent_embedded.description: Consent window, under the question, when a frame of another site embedded in the page asked.

consent_body.message: The site will see the sending device's camera and hear its microphone, and its sound can go to the sending device instead of this computer.

consent_note.message: You can change this later in the Extensions menu (the puzzle-piece icon) › Remote Visio Camera.
consent_note.description: Consent window, small print. Chrome's Extensions menu, whose toolbar icon is a puzzle piece.

consent_invalid.message: This request is no longer valid.
consent_invalid.description: Consent window opened without a valid site.

slate_down_direct.message: No device is paired with this browser
slate_down_direct.description: Slate in direct mode (no Remote Visio app; the extension connects to a paired device itself): no device is paired yet.

slate_down_direct_hint.message: Click the Remote Visio icon in the toolbar, then Pair a device.
slate_down_direct_hint.description: Slate, under slate_down_direct. "Pair a device" is popup_pair.

slate_waiting_hint_direct.message: Open remotevisio.com/send on your device and press Start.
slate_waiting_hint_direct.description: Slate in direct mode, under slate_waiting: the paired device sends no camera, or is not started. remotevisio.com/send is a web address, not translated.

popup_connection.description: Popup, Mac only: the label of the choice between the Remote Visio app and direct mode.

popup_connection_auto.description: Popup, connection choice: use the app when it runs, otherwise a paired device.

popup_connection_app.message: Remote Visio app on this Mac

popup_connection_direct.description: Popup, connection choice: the extension connects to a paired device itself.

popup_direct_title.description: Popup, title of the card about paired devices (direct mode: no Remote Visio app needed).

popup_direct_connected.description: Popup, direct mode: a paired device is connected. The device's name is shown in bold.

popup_direct_waiting.description: Popup, direct mode: a device is paired, none is connected.

popup_direct_waiting_hint.message: Open remotevisio.com/send on it and press Start.
popup_direct_waiting_hint.description: Popup, under popup_direct_waiting. remotevisio.com/send is a web address, not translated.

popup_direct_unpaired.description: Popup, direct mode: no device is paired with this browser.

popup_direct_offline.description: Popup, direct mode: the connection to the website, which devices use to reach this browser, is down.

popup_direct_app_chosen.message: Your paired devices cannot connect while the Remote Visio app is chosen above.
popup_direct_app_chosen.description: Popup, direct card, when the user chose the Remote Visio app on this Mac: direct mode is off (the hub is closed).

popup_direct_or_pair.message: You can also pair a device and use this browser without the Remote Visio app.
popup_direct_or_pair.description: Popup, direct mode not set up yet (the app not chosen, running or not): direct mode needs only the extension and a paired device.

popup_direct_failed.message: Remote Visio could not start in this browser
popup_direct_failed.description: Popup, direct mode: the extension's background page for direct mode did not start.

popup_pair.description: Popup button: starts pairing a phone, tablet or computer that will send its microphone and camera to this browser.

popup_pair_scan.message: Scan this code with the device you will send from, or open the link on it.
popup_pair_scan.description: Popup, pairing: under the QR code.

popup_pair_copy.description: Popup, pairing: copies the pairing link.

popup_pair_copied.description: Popup, pairing: the link was copied.

popup_pair_expires.description: Popup, pairing: the countdown of the pairing link. TIME is minutes and seconds, as 9:58.

popup_pair_verifying.description: Popup, pairing: a device opened the link, the pairing goes on.

popup_pair_waiting_approval.description: Popup, pairing: the approval window waits for the number shown on the device.

popup_pair_review.description: Popup, pairing: brings the approval window to the front.

popup_pair_confirming.message: Waiting for the device to confirm…
popup_pair_confirming.description: Popup, pairing: approved here, the device's user still has to confirm.

popup_pair_done.description: Popup, pairing: done. The device's name is shown in bold.

popup_pair_failed.message: The pairing did not finish. Pair again to try once more.
popup_pair_failed.description: Popup, pairing: refused, cancelled, or the device could not prove it had the link.

popup_pair_expired.description: Popup, pairing: nobody used the link within 10 minutes.

popup_pair_error.message: Could not start a pairing. Check the connection to remotevisio.com and try again.
popup_pair_error.description: Popup, pairing: the pairing could not start.

popup_pair_full.message: This browser already has 16 paired devices. Remove one to pair another.

popup_pair_larger.description: Popup, pairing: opens the QR code in a larger window, for scanning through a remote-desktop window.

popup_devices.description: Popup, direct mode: the list of paired devices.

popup_device_never_used.description: Popup, a paired device that never connected.

popup_device_expires.description: Popup, a paired device: devices not used for 60 days are removed.

popup_device_remove.description: Popup, a paired device: unpairs it; it can no longer connect.

popup_device_connected.description: Popup, a paired device that is connected now.

popup_device_unnamed.description: Popup and approval window: a device that sent no name.

popup_browser_name.description: Popup, direct mode: the name paired devices show for this browser.

popup_browser_name_hint.message: Your paired devices show this name.

popup_hint_no_address.message: This computer has no private network address that web pages can connect to.
popup_hint_no_address.description: Popup, direct mode: web pages cannot reach the extension's connections.

popup_hint_webrtc_blocked.message: Web pages cannot connect to Remote Visio here. A setting, an extension (for example a 'prevent WebRTC leak' option) or a policy may block local WebRTC connections.
popup_hint_webrtc_blocked.description: Popup, direct mode: pages failed to connect several times.

popup_status_down_direct.message: No device is paired with this browser
popup_status_down_direct.description: Popup status in direct mode: no device paired yet.

popup_speaker_not_listening_hint_direct.message: Press Start in Remote Visio on your device.
popup_speaker_not_listening_hint_direct.description: Popup, speaker row in direct mode: the paired device is not started.

pair_title.message: A device wants to pair with this browser

pair_body.message: Once paired, it can send its microphone and camera to the sites you allow here, and hear their sound.

pair_type_number.message: Type the number shown on your device
pair_type_number.description: Approval window (pairing): above the 6-digit field. The number is never shown on this computer.

pair_number_mismatch.message: That number doesn't match. Check the number on your device.
pair_number_mismatch.description: Approval window (pairing): a wrong number was typed.

pair_tries_left.description: Approval window (pairing): after a wrong number.

pair_from.description: Approval window (pairing): the country the device connects from, as the relay saw it (a two-letter code).

pair_timeout.message: This pairing no longer waits for approval.
pair_timeout.description: Approval window: the pairing ended (timed out, cancelled or done).

pair_show_title.description: The large QR code window: its title.
